src='''def transform(grid):
    """Arrow recolor: find the arrow (vertical bar + horizontal arm at one end,
    arm >= 2 cells). Among all sets of congruent (rotation/reflection
    equivalent) non-arrow objects with >= 2 members, take the set containing
    the largest object, and recolor its leftmost member (tie: lowest) to the
    arrow's color. Verified on all 5 demo pairs of task-b89852a9."""
    from collections import deque
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # 4-connected objects
    objs = []
    seen = set()
    for r0 in range(len(grid)):
        for c0 in range(len(grid[0])):
            if grid[r0][c0] != bg and (r0, c0) not in seen:
                col = grid[r0][c0]
                q = deque([(r0, c0)]); seen.add((r0, c0)); cells = []
                while q:
                    y, x = q.popleft(); cells.append((y, x))
                    for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                        if 0 <= ny < len(grid) and 0 <= nx < len(grid[0]) \\
                                and grid[ny][nx] == col and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny, nx)); q.append((ny, nx))
                objs.append((col, cells))

    # arrow: vertical bar (>=3) plus horizontal arm (>=2) at one bar end
    def variants(cells):
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        k=frozenset((y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells)
        out=set()
        for f in [lambda y,x:(y,x),lambda y,x:(x,y),lambda y,x:(y,-x),lambda y,x:(x,-y),
                  lambda y,x:(-y,x),lambda y,x:(-x,y),lambda y,x:(-y,-x),lambda y,x:(-x,-y)]:
            v=[f(y,x) for y,x in k]
            my=min(a for a,b in v); mx=min(b for a,b in v)
            out.add(frozenset((a-my,b-mx) for a,b in v))
        return out

    arrow=None
    for col,cells in objs:
        colcount={}
        for y,x in cells: colcount.setdefault(x,[]).append(y)
        for x,ys in colcount.items():
            ys=sorted(ys)
            for a in range(len(ys)):
                for b in range(a+2,len(ys)):
                    if ys[b]-ys[a]==b-a and b-a+1>=3:
                        for end in (ys[a],ys[b]):
                            arm=[x2 for y2,x2 in cells if y2==end and x2!=x]
                            others=[(y2,x2) for y2,x2 in cells if y2!=end and x2!=x]
                            if len(arm)>=2 and all(y2==end for y2,x2 in others):
                                arrow=(col,cells)
                    if arrow: break
                if arrow: break
            if arrow: break
        if arrow: break
    acol,acells=arrow

    groups=[]
    for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(objs):
        if cells is acells: continue
        placed=False
        for grp in groups:
            if variants(objs[grp[0]][1]) & variants(cells):
                grp.append(i); placed=True; break
        if not placed: groups.append([i])
    groups=[g_ for g_ in groups if len(g_)>=2]
    best=max(groups, key=lambda g_: len(objs[g_[0]][1]))
    tgt=min(best, key=lambda i:(min(x for y,x in objs[i][1]), -min(y for y,x in objs[i][1])))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for y,x in objs[tgt][1]: out[y][x]=acol
    return out
'''
